# Core Bluetooth BLE workflows for iOS in Swift

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the repo states no license, so no content is reproduced): @dpearson2699's Core Bluetooth reference for Swift/iOS — scan for, connect to and exchange data with Bluetooth Low Energy devices: the central role (CBCentralManager scanning, connecting, service/characteristic discovery, read/write/notify with write-flow control and payload limits), the peripheral role (publishing services and advertising with CBPeripheralManager), Bluetooth authorization and Info.plist keys, background BLE modes, state restoration after app termination, a common-mistakes table (scan before poweredOn, unretained peripherals, nil scans in production) and a review checklist. Honest caveats: iOS/macOS development only — needs Xcode, the Apple development requirements (NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription, background mode entitlements) and real BLE hardware for real testing; license not stated by the source repo — short listing with a link only, nothing copied.
